concerns.text: T007 is tagged [P] 'parallel after T003', but its verification requires that 'the descriptor-error count appears in data/results/ outputs' — an artifact produced by T008 (reports/results.json assembly). As scheduled (parallel after T003, potentially before T008), T007's acceptance check cannot pass. Either move T007 after T008, split the results-surfacing assertion into T008, or restrict T007's verification to the log-vs-CSV consistency check only.

T007 adds tests to code/tests/test_features.py, the same file T003 creates. Marked [P] relative to T003 this is fine (T003 precedes it), but the shared-file edit means T007 is not safely parallel with any other task touching that file; the dependency note should state T007 runs strictly after T003 completes, not merely 'parallel after T003'.
